note: Demonstration policy for the Layer Three structural skeleton. The memory laws in force — how fast unprotected memories fade (halflife_days), how faint a memory may become before it is pruned (prune_threshold), which tags are never forgotten (protected_tags), and how many episodes about one tag trigger a consolidation pass (consolidate_min_episodes) — are data, not code: revise this file to change the policy; no code change is required.
